findings.evidence: `grep -n '\.EPS' code/` matches only the field declaration at line 78; lines 89, 97, 155, 167 all re-introduce `EPS` as a parameter.
findings.fix: Define `structureOne K`, `structureTwo K`, `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition K G A` and the constructor from `K.EPS` and drop the explicit `EPS` parameter (this also matches the roadmap signature `fromG1G2 g K c₁ c₂`); or, if the form is to stay a free parameter, delete the `EPS` field and the `SpinKinematics` structure and take `PolarizedKinematics g`.
findings.issue: `SpinKinematics.EPS` is free data: no declaration anywhere uses `K.EPS`. Every structure/predicate/constructor takes a separate `EPS : V [⋀^Fin 4]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ` argument, so `structureOne EPS K` may be applied with `EPS ≠ K.EPS`, the field is unconstrained by any law, and `SpinKinematics` adds nothing over `PolarizedKinematics` for every result in the file.

The roadmap's explicit Layer 0.2 products are `IsG1G2Decomposition g K G W`, `fromG1G2` and `fromG1G2_isDecomposition`, "named and shaped to match" `IsF1F2Decomposition`/`fromF1F2`; later layers consume `fromG1G2 g K c₁ c₂` (0.3 Examples). The PR exports `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` / `fromAlternatingCoefficients` instead, and `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` sits in the same namespace as the unrelated `IsPolarizedDecomposition` of `Polarized/Basic.lean`.

findings.evidence: Lines 181-185 contain only prose; `grep -rn sorryful` matches other modules but not this file.
findings.fix: Either add the declaration (roadmap 0.2 uniqueness / coefficient extraction) or rewrite the section as a stated gap and drop the description of a nonexistent proof; same for the module-header claim that `E₁`, `E₂` "form a basis".
findings.issue: The closing doc section "## Uniqueness of the decomposition" describes the proof of an existence statement ("constructs `c₁`, `c₂` explicitly by projecting `A` onto the two basis vectors") that no declaration in the file provides; the PR description likewise advertises a `@[sorryful]` main uniqueness theorem that is absent. Readers of the module header are told the file contains a result it does not export.

summary: The new `SpinKinematics` carries an `EPS` field that no declaration in the file ever reads, while every operation takes a redundant explicit `EPS` parameter, so the kinematic record and the structures it is supposed to orient are disconnected. The exported surface also misses the roadmap's named products (`IsG1G2Decomposition`, `fromG1G2`) and almost all of the characteristic API the analogous `fromF1F2` carries.
